game.name: World Snooker Championship 2007 (Europe)
game.desc: World Snooker Championship 2007 is a billiards game for Xbox 360. It features Snooker, Pool (9-ball and 8-ball) or Trickshot, as well as versus and quick game modes. The title also offers a new challenge, called hybrid, which combines snooker and pool in the same tournament. Customise your avatar and get ready to take on the best pool players around.
